name: wecom
description: WeCom (WeChat Work) enterprise collaboration plugin: messaging, contacts, meetings, schedules, todos, docs, spreadsheets, smart sheets. All operations go through the external `wecom-cli` command-line program.

setup.label: Path to the wecom-cli executable (must be on PATH)

interface.shortDescription: WeCom enterprise collaboration: messaging, contacts, meetings, schedules, todos, documents
interface.longDescription: WeCom plugin. All operations are executed through the external `wecom-cli` command-line program (`wecom-cli <category> <tool> '<json>'`). The plugin ships the skill documentation only; you must provide the `wecom-cli` binary and WeCom credentials (access token / bot id / secret) yourself, usually via environment variables, because duya does not bundle native binaries or authenticate against WeCom directly.
